description: This file is the entry point for a React application, importing React and ReactDOM libraries, stylesheet, and the main App component, then rendering the App component into the DOM.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the app into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders a React element (the App component wrapped in StrictMode) into the root DOM node.
